title: CKS-ADHM-1-2026: The Indictment of the Continuum Priest
abstract: We provide a formal ad hominem and structural indictment of the "Status Quo Kernel" (embodied by the fictional Dr. Physicist). While the Cymatic K-Space (CKS) framework derives all fundamental constants from two axioms and a single integer \( N \), the standing scientific establishment maintains a "19-Parameter Epicycle Museum." This paper documents the logical bankruptcy, temporal fraud, and architectural denial inherent in current consensus models. We demonstrate that the accusation of "fitting" leveled against CKS is a psychological projection intended to mask the insolvency of a model that can no longer calculate without "Dark" ghosts and "String" fantasies.
